top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks are a mature, repeatedly realized measurement advance with established value for precision measurement and tests of fundamental physics. The Katori–Ye pairing gives the achievement a plausible, focused attribution; the citation should remain limited to developing and realizing the clocks, pending review of the historical division of credit.
recusal_note: My profile notes that committee colleagues Göran Johansson and Eva Olsson are in the same Gothenburg physics environment as me. No connection to Katori, Ye, or optical lattice-clock work is apparent.
